data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 沙发前解开耳机线
data.description: 舱室里响起暖气送风声。斯卡蒂坐在沙发前的圆地毯上，把缠在一起的耳机线一点点理开。台灯照着卫衣前的小白鲸图案，毛绒拖鞋还松松地套在脚上。
data.location: 居住舱沙发前的圆地毯
data.action: 盘坐在地毯上用双手理顺耳机线
data.lighting: 沙发边的台灯照着连帽衫和掌心的细线
data.promptProse: Skadi sits on the round rug with a tangle of headphone cable in her hands. A small white orca is printed on her oversized charcoal hoodie over black lounge shorts, and plush slippers rest loosely on her feet. The only light comes from a lamp beside the sofa.
data.animaCaption: She draws one loose loop free while the headphones rest on the rug by her slippers.
